item.skycraft.lockpick.desc: Used to pick locked chests. Fragile.
crime.skycraft.confiscated: Your stolen items have been confiscated (%s)
crime.skycraft.guard.arrest: Stop right there, criminal scum! You have committed crimes against Skyrim and her people. What say you in your defense?
crime.skycraft.guard.cant_afford: You don't have the %s gold. Then pay with your blood... or come quietly.
crime.skycraft.guard.paid_line: %s: Smart choice. Your stolen goods have been confiscated. Now behave yourself.
crime.skycraft.guard.bribed_line: %s: Fine. I didn't see anything. Now get out of my sight.
crime.skycraft.guard.persuaded_line: %s: Fine. But I'll be keeping an eye on you.
crime.skycraft.guard.intimidated_line: %s: I... I don't want any trouble. Just keep moving.
crime.skycraft.guard.persuade_failed: Nice try, but I'm not falling for that. Pay the fine or go to jail.
crime.skycraft.guard.intimidate_failed: Is that a threat? You're only making this worse for yourself.
dialogue.skycraft.crime.pay: I'd like to pay off my bounty. (%s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.crime.bribe: (Bribe) Maybe I could pay you to look the other way? (%s gold)
dialogue.skycraft.crime.intimidate: (Intimidate) Do you really want to fight the Dragonborn? (%s%%)
dialogue.skycraft.crime.resist: You'll never take me alive! (Resist arrest)
crime.skycraft.rumor.0: I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I took an arrow in the knee...
crime.skycraft.rumor.1: Let me guess... someone stole your sweetroll.
crime.skycraft.rumor.4: Keep your nose clean, and you won't have any trouble with me.
crime.skycraft.rumor.5: Plenty of folk lost their purses on the market square last week. Keep a hand on yours.
crime.skycraft.rumor.6: Heard tell of bandits camped in the hills. Wouldn't wander there alone.
crime.skycraft.rumor.7: Disrespect the law, and you disrespect me.
crime.skycraft.lock.need_pick: This %s is locked (%s). You need a lockpick.
crime.skycraft.lock.cant_break: It's locked (%s). Pick the lock instead.
crime.skycraft.pickpocket.caught_line: %s: Hey! Get your hands off me!
crime.skycraft.jail.title: Jail
crime.skycraft.jail.deteriorate: Your time in jail has caused your skills to deteriorate.
screen.skycraft.pickpocket.title: Pickpocket: %s
screen.skycraft.pickpocket.hint: Click an item to steal it. Esc to stop.
screen.skycraft.lockpick.title: Lockpicking
screen.skycraft.lockpick.hint: Mouse: move the pick   Hold A / D: turn the lock   Esc: stop
